protocol.architecture: Original DBNN double-exponential filters, zero-diagonal dense quadratic, linear sum, bias, event reset
protocol.selection_rule: Before test evaluation, select checkpoint+reset on pooled validation masked MSE + 0.5*(1-micro F1 at +/-5 ms). RMSE and both VE variances exclude reference AP +/-10 ms. Select visualization examples only after locking, using actual event matches and voltage error within each spike class; disclose this rule.
protocol.loss: Masked per-trace voltage MSE + 0.1 first-difference MSE; optional reference-event threshold hinge + hard-negative threshold penalty. Balanced trial uses 0.5 absolute + 0.5 variance-normalized voltage MSE (variance floor .25 mV^2). EMA decay .995 after each update.
protocol.fit_target: Exact quantized-event NEURON replay; teacher reset from full-active adapted initialization; ref AP +/-10 ms removed for voltage loss. Event labels retain AP times.
